name: Node jsonwebtoken algorithm-confusion (CVE-2022-23529)
description: jsonwebtoken before 9.0.0 allows algorithm confusion attacks including 'none' or asymmetric/symmetric mismatch.
rationale: Token authentication flaws break NIST IA-2 (identification) and IA-5 (authenticator management). PCI DSS 8.3.1/8.3.2 require secure authentication mechanisms. OWASP ASVS 3.5.3 mandates stateless tokens be signed using strong algorithms with a pre-defined allowlist.
